items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was in Brussels… in Antwerp, right, with John Zorn.

ctx.x: [imitates] [laughs] And we… he was in Brussels… in Antwerp, right, with John Zorn. And I asked him… we crossed… “Mr. Play blue and green.” [laughs] And these guys, you know… Joey and Greg Cohen, the bass player… they’re [bad guys?].

Well, we’re going to talk about why or how is it that you are able to stay so current. You’re always, you know, like moving forward. You’re never like resting on your achievements. You’re never like, oh, well…
